packageRules.description: The age gate is unsatisfiable for digest updates: a floating tag's current digest is always the tip (often <10d old), and action digests resolve without a release timestamp so the stability check pends forever. Let digests ride the weekly schedule; versioned updates keep the 10-day lag.

transformTemplates: ($version := releases[$match(version, /^\s*Version:/)].version; $created := releases[$match(version, /^Created:/)].version; $assert($count($version) = 1 and $count($created) = 1, 'Expected one Version and Created line'); { "releases": [{ "version": $trim($substringAfter($version, 'Version:')), "releaseTimestamp": $trim($substringAfter($created, 'Created:')) }] })
